integrity_statement: Analytical finite-epoch proof and exact rational verification are supplied; limited self-review only; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One epoch with one unrelaxed projection per labeled row, initial error equal to the repeated row normal, and consistent planar systems.

The exact all-multiplicity threshold is for all but one identical row directions and one exceptional direction; an exact all-distinct three-row counterexample establishes robustness but not a full general classification.
No claim about all initial directions, optimal sampling policies, worst-case iteration complexity, or asymptotic multi-epoch convergence.
A specialized earlier treatment of the exact redundant-row switch polynomial remains a residual publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp multiplicity threshold for one-epoch Kaczmarz reshuffling reversal
